title: Chemical emissions from organic light-emitting diode screens during use and thermal treatment
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EM00202A, Paper
Yunhe Guo, Yi Wang, Yanna Liu, Yuhao Yan, Kun Zhang, Guangbo Qu, Guibin Jiang
Organic light-emitting diode (OLED) screens are widely used display products today, yet chemical emissions during normal use and end-of-life handling remain poorly characterized.
